scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.format: prettier --write backend/src backend/test backend/scripts backend/prisma.config.ts frontend/src frontend/tests frontend/*.ts docs README.md compose.yaml .github/workflows
scripts.format:check: prettier --check backend/src backend/test backend/scripts backend/prisma.config.ts frontend/src frontend/tests frontend/*.ts docs README.md compose.yaml .github/workflows
